name: AYRES, the Hon. Timothy (Tim)
research_notes: Initial pass 2026-09-16. All three frozen official occupation spells preserved. Party biography adds Riverina-to-Sydney transition in 2000; organiser spell remains one interval to avoid duplicate counting.

First speech establishes childhood fencing/cattle work and ACTU Organising Works cadetship. Neither is assigned paid/full-time status without evidence. Family-farm work is not automatically self-employment; participant in training is not automatically ACTU employee.

Unresolved gap: official secretary endpoint is 2017, Senate service starts 2019-07-01. AMWU successor announcement confirms departure after preselection but no exact cessation date or payroll status through 2019. Do not extend union employment to Senate entry or assume paid campaigning.

First speech's broad statement about 25 years of workplace experience does not identify employer-specific dates or FTE and cannot replace the 1996 official organiser start. Cadet date must not be inferred from the national program's 1994 inception.

Searches attempted: official/party/personal biography; first speech; AMWU successor and archives; 2017–2019 employment and annual-report searches; full-time and director searches. Namesake results for British artist/Canadian realtor excluded. Superannuation search results referring to other people not adopted.

Follow-up priority: ACTU cadet cohort and host union/payroll evidence, early jobs/university dates, AMWU annual officer returns and financial reports around 2017–2019, leave/cessation, ALP national-executive remuneration/dates and any paid governance roles. Last attempted 2026-09-16. Advance initial national pass before repeating queries.
